result.title: CatchUp: Depth-Aware Re-Admission of Visual Tokens for Efficient Large Vision-Language Models
result.summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) repeatedly process hundreds of visual tokens across decoder layers, incurring substantial computation and memory costs. Existing inference-time visual token pruning methods often irreversibly remove low-ranked tokens, although the set of visual tokens receiving high query-conditioned attention can change across decoder depth. Recoverable routing preserves skipped tokens for later reconsideration, but re-admits them with stale representations after bypassing intermediate transformations. We further find that replacing stale re-admitted states with their current-depth oracle states from a full-token reference trajectory substantially improves grounding performance. We therefore propose CatchUp, a training-free framework for depth-aware visual-token re-admission. CatchUp repeatedly re-evaluates query-conditioned visual relevance, processes only selected visual tokens through each decoder interval, and preserves deferred tokens for later re-admission. Upon re-admission, CatchUp approximates missed representation evolution using reference-to-current transition signals from semantically and spatially related visual tokens. Across three referring-expression grounding datasets and six multimodal benchmarks, CatchUp achieves the highest average relative retention in both benchmark groups at 64-, 128-, and 192-token budgets. At a 64-token budget with 88.9% fewer active visual tokens, CatchUp retains 92.17% of the full model's performance on average across six multimodal benchmarks while reducing end-to-end latency by 8.0%. Code is available at https://github.com/pej0918/CatchUp

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 CatchUp，一种免训练、深度感知的视觉 token「再准入」框架：在每个解码区间重估查询条件下的视觉相关性，只计算被选中的 token，并把被推迟的 token 留待后续再准入，再准入时用语义与空间相关 token 的参考—当前转移信号近似其缺失的表示演化，以在低 token 预算下保住 grounding 与多模态基准性能。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接触及视觉细节是否保留在内部状态、以及随解码深度被裁剪后如何恢复的问题；其「延迟再准入状态陈旧使 grounding 变差、替换为当前深度 oracle 状态可显著回升」的发现，可供核查 LVR 中信息坍缩、动态视觉证据筛选与状态更新的联系。
